chunks: There will come in the chapter about the wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) what pertains to Umm Salama, who is the Mother of the Believers, and it was said that she was the best of his wives after Khadija, may Allah grant her peace.

And sufficient honour and trustworthiness for her is that when al-Husayn (peace be upon him) headed to Iraq, he deposited with her the testament and the books and other things, and said to her: 'When your eldest son comes to you, hand over to him what I gave you.'

So when al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was martyred, Ali ibn al-Husayn came to Umm Salama, and she handed over to him everything that al-Husayn (peace be upon him) had given her, as will come in its place.

And know that the one who traces the narrations of this encyclopedia may find the names of a group of narrators within it, and we did not intend to be exhaustive in this book (Book of Narrators), and Allah is the Granter of Success and to Him is the Return.
And it will come regarding Umm Ayman that she is from the inhabitants of Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What was the role of Umm Salama in preserving the testament of Imam al-Husayn?
ai.summary: The text underscores Umm Salama’s elevated status as a trusted custodian of the Prophet’s testament and books, highlighting her pivotal role in transmitting these sacred items to Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn following the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn. This narrative not only affirms her piety and reliability but also connects the lineage of prophetic knowledge directly to the Imams, while briefly noting Umm Ayman’s inclusion among the inhabitants of Paradise.
